app.name: Agents Tray Limits
app.description: Shows ChatGPT and Codex limits and usage statistics in the GNOME top panel.

hints.codex_not_found: Install Codex CLI, run codex in a terminal, and sign in with ChatGPT.
hints.not_logged_in: Run codex in a terminal and select Sign in with ChatGPT.
hints.unsupported_auth: An API key reports API billing, not ChatGPT subscription limits. Sign in to Codex with ChatGPT instead.
hints.codex_too_old: Update Codex CLI and try again.
hints.timeout: Check your internet connection. If necessary, allow Codex wider network access.
hints.app_server_stopped: Make sure Codex runs with a compatible Node.js version; for NVM, use the path to its launcher.
hints.python_not_found: The helper uses only the Python 3 standard library.
